wizard.legal.privacyBody:
PRIVACY POLICY
Edition of July 29, 2026

This Privacy Policy (hereinafter — the "Policy") defines how LLP "Sergei Zamkovoi" (BIN 220640014056, registered at: Republic of Kazakhstan, Aktau, 14th microdistrict, 61) (hereinafter — the "Operator") collects, processes, and protects the personal data of Users of the "Harmonizer" mobile application (hereinafter — the "App").

1. WHAT DATA THE OPERATOR COLLECTS AND WHY
The Operator collects only the data necessary for the App's services to work correctly:
— Name and email address: used for registration, authentication (by sending a 6-digit OTP code), saving practice progress across the User's devices, and communication.
— Date, exact time, and place of birth, as well as the current geolocation: used exclusively to calculate the astrological chart in order to personalize and form individual yoga practice recommendations for the current day.
— Usage data (statistics): information about completed lessons and yoga practices is used to display reports within the App.

2. LEGAL GROUNDS AND DATA PROCESSING
2.1. Personal data is processed in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan "On Personal Data and Their Protection".
2.2. Processing is based on the User's consent, expressed by continuing registration in the App.
2.3. The Operator does not transfer the User's personal data to third parties, except where necessary for the App's infrastructure to work (for example, the service sending OTP codes by email) or where required by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

3. DATA PROTECTION AND STORAGE
3.1. The Operator takes all necessary technical and organizational measures to protect the User's personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, or deletion.
3.2. Data is stored on secured servers for the entire period the User uses the App.

4. USER RIGHTS AND CONTACTS
4.1. The User has the right to request deletion of their account and all related personal data at any time.
4.2. To exercise their rights or obtain clarification, the User may send a request via the feedback form in the App or by email: sergei@zamkovoi.yoga.
wizard.legal.termsBody:
USER AGREEMENT (OFFER CONTRACT)
Edition of July 29, 2026

This User Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the "Agreement") is a public offer by TOO "Sergei Zamkovoi" (BIN 220640014056, registered at: Republic of Kazakhstan, Aktau, 14th microdistrict, 61) (hereinafter referred to as the "Administration") and defines the terms of use of the mobile application "Harmonizer" (hereinafter referred to as the "Application") by the User.
By starting to use the Application (by logging in with email/entering an OTP code), the User unconditionally accepts the terms of this Agreement.

1. SERVICES AND FUNCTIONALITY PROVIDED
1.1. The Application is a free interactive personal account for participants of Sergei Zamkovoi's proprietary educational courses. The Application provides technical access to learning materials, personalized daily recommendations, methodological materials and videos, as well as the schedule of live online consultations.

2. ACCESS TO MATERIALS
2.1. The mobile application is distributed free of charge.
2.2. Access to specific sections of the personal account, proprietary study programs, and weekly webinars is granted exclusively to individuals enrolled in training on the official website of Sergei Zamkovoi - https://zamkovoi.yoga. Management of access, accounts, and study plans is carried out by the user outside the mobile application.

3. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY AND HEALTH WARNING
3.1. Physical activity warning: yoga practice, meditation, and breathing techniques can significantly affect physical and mental condition. The User confirms that they have no medical contraindications to physical and breathing exercises. The Application is not a medical service and does not replace a doctor's consultation. The Administration is not liable for any injuries or deterioration of the User's well-being arising from performing the practices.
3.2. Disclaimer of warranties ("As Is"): The Application is provided on an "as is" basis. The Administration makes every effort to ensure stable and error-free operation of the Application, especially regarding the display of yoga practices. However, the Administration does not guarantee that the Application will function absolutely uninterrupted, quickly, and without errors.
3.3. Daily personalized recommendations generated based on the User's data are part of the author's self-regulation methodology and are of a purely introductory, philosophical, and informational nature.

4. FEEDBACK AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
4.1. All inquiries, complaints, and suggestions from Users are accepted through the feedback form integrated into the Application's interface, or via email: sergei@zamkovoi.yoga.
4.2. This Agreement is governed by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
wizard.step2.body: Enter your date, time, and place of birth to use the personal archetypal states navigator. It links planetary cycles with Jungian archetypes' psychology, and each day shows the most effective way to navigate life situations.
wizard.step2.title: Archetype Navigator Setup
wizard.step3.body1: We go to the gym to train our bodies. But very few train their mind. As a result, mental illnesses are even more common than physical ones.
wizard.step3.body2: Learn to see the flow of life’s events as a gym for your soul, and act — lift the little ‘dumbbells’. The Harmonizer will help you spot practices behind seemingly mundane events.
wizard.step3.body3: And in 7 days, it will gather enough data to generate unique psychological reports: about the thickness of your lifeline, your bistochastic state matrix, your presence in various life areas, and it will start acting as a wise mentor.
wizard.step3.title: From astrology to psychology
wizard.step4.body1: Changing habits, re‑examining your behavioral, emotional, and mental patterns is very difficult. And this is where yoga comes to help.
wizard.step4.body2: For this, we practice yoga not only as a way to become more flexible, slimmer, and healthier, but also as a tool for managing your inner state, based on an understanding of psychosomatics, removing blocks, fears, resentments, addictions, guilt, etc.
wizard.step4.body3: The Harmonizer offers about 200 very unusual yoga practices that, thanks to synchronization with planetary rhythms, quickly lead to a truly noticeable change in the quality of your life. You’ll notice it on the very first day!
wizard.step4.title: From psychology to yoga
wizard.step5.body1: Breathing is the most powerful harmonizing tool. To make the breathing practice work on a mystically deep level, the Harmonizer uses biofeedback — adjusting the breathing pattern to your pulse in real time, plus accompanying the practice with a special visualization and binaural sound at brainwave frequencies (alpha, theta, delta).
wizard.step5.body2: All this quickly shuts off the internal dialogue, relaxes the mind, and induces a deep meditative state where breathing practices bring maximum effect.
wizard.step5.body3: And the reports will show you what is happening to your body during that time.
wizard.step5.title: From body to breath
wizard.step6.body1: Most apps leave you alone with algorithms — so motivation quickly fades, discipline doesn’t hold, and results are minimal. Understanding this, I see personal communication as the most important element of our interaction.
wizard.step6.body2: Every week I hold live online consultations. Using real examples and participants’ questions, we discuss which techniques suit various life situations, adjust our inner attitude, overcome laziness and other obstacles.
wizard.step6.body3: We don’t need practices for the sake of practices. I believe every step should bring a positive result!
wizard.step6.title: Live support
wizard.step7.body1: My name is Sergey Zamkovoy. I have been practicing yoga as a way to explore life, the body, and consciousness since my student days (since the 1980s). I hold a degree in psychology (psychology teacher).
wizard.step7.body2: On YouTube you’ll find many of my videos, and on the website — a series of deep online courses that over 80,000 people have taken, as well as the book ‘Yoga — the Wizard’s Path’.
wizard.step7.body3: We live in a very difficult time. The info-sphere is overflowing with anxiety, and at the same time skepticism towards techniques that could support us.
wizard.step7.body4: That’s why I developed this app, so you can use it daily for restoration and harmonization.
wizard.step7.title: About the author
